nodes.label: num-embeddings data archive listing (12 dataset folders)
nodes.rationale: Kept as small metadata in place of the ~3.2GB archive: adult, california, churn, covtype, eye, fb-comments, gesture, higgs-small, house, microsoft, otto, santander — each with X_num_{train,val,test}.npy, y_*, idx_*, info.json and a READY marker. Only higgs-small, fb-comments and santander are actually loaded by benchmarks.py.

nodes.label: READY marker file convention
nodes.rationale: A per-dataset-folder sentinel confirming extraction fully succeeded, so a half-extracted archive can't silently produce a wrong-split benchmark run.

edges.source_location: overlapping datasets, different array naming (X_num_* vs N_*)
